summary.title: Awesome CTO
summary.one_liner: A curated, opinionated link list of reading for CTOs and VP R&D, focused on startups, covering hiring, management, architecture, data, finance and product.
takeaways: Find curated articles on the CTO role, including how it differs from VP Engineering
Locate hiring, interviewing and people management reading for engineering leaders
Review development process, architecture and data resources, such as Twelve-Factor App and microservice critiques
Access startup finance, equity and due diligence material, plus product and marketing links
summary.summary: Awesome CTO is a GitHub-hosted, curated list of links aimed at Chief Technology Officers and VP R&D, with an emphasis on startups and hyper-growth companies. The page is organized into sections such as CTO Position, Hiring, People Management, Career Growth, Project Management, Development Process, Architecture, Technologies, Data, Startups, Due Diligence, Money/Finance, Product, and Marketing, plus Books and More links. Each entry is a title with the author or source named in parentheses or after a dash, pointing to external articles, GitHub repositories, and Quora threads. The page itself contains no original explanations, so its value is as a navigational index.
